title: Blind read-back record
description: A blind read-back (K5, D39; tiers 1 and 2), stored as machine evidence. The read-back never sees the source: the harness stages only the declaration's slice into an empty temporary directory and runs the model tool-less. The host wraps the validated `output` (pass `$defs/output` to the CLI) with the provenance only it knows. Freshness covers the input (subject and slice), prompt, schema and model settings (D39).

id.description: The evidence id, `readback:<decl>@<s12>.<d12>:<channel>:<p12>` (p12: the first 12 hex digits of prompt_sha256).

slice_sha256.description: sha256 of the staged slice the model read.

prompt_sha256.description: sha256 of the exact prompt text sent (template filled in).

schema_sha256.description: sha256 of the output schema passed to the CLI (`$defs/output` of this schema, serialised).

repaired.description: The one repair turn was used: the first answer failed schema validation.

allOf.description: The channel is the model's provider.
The channel is the model's provider.

output.description: The blind reading (the model-facing part). The model sees only the staged slice (the declaration and the definitions it depends on, doc comments and source hints stripped), never the source.

informal_statement.description: The declaration's meaning in ordinary mathematical language, as read from the Lean alone.

name.description: The name as it appears in the slice.

meaning.description: What it denotes, as read from its definition.

name.description: The binder or field name, or null if anonymous.

quantifier_structure.description: The quantifier and binder structure (what is universally or existentially quantified, over what, in which order).

role.description: The role it plays in the statement.

uncertainties.description: What the reader could not determine, or read with doubt.

decl.description: An absolute Lean declaration id as `Name.toString` prints it (the ids `tracker graph` uses).

fingerprintId.description: Evidence id of a fingerprint record: `fingerprint:<decl>@<s12>.<d12>`, the first 12 hex digits of the statement fingerprint and of the digest.

model.description: The model call, as the host ran it (never written by the model).
The model id the CLI reported (resolved, not an alias).

effort.description: The reasoning effort passed to the CLI, in its own vocabulary (for example `max`, `xhigh`, `high`).

provider.description: The model CLI: `claude` (Claude Code, `claude -p`) or `codex` (`codex exec`).

sha256.description: A SHA-256 hash: `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hex digits.

subject.description: The declaration reviewed, bound to its fingerprints and its fingerprint record.

statement.description: The statement fingerprint at review time.

digest.description: The transitive digest at review time.

evidence.description: The fingerprint record that holds both.

usage.description: Token and cost usage as the CLI reported it, kept verbatim (deliberately open: each CLI has its own fields).
